mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, shop_id, total_amount, freight_amount, discount_amount, pay_amount, status, address_snapshot, pay_type, pay_time, remark, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM orders WHERE status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0 AND create_time < #{now} ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{timeoutMinutes}
